{{short description|Swedish food scientist}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2025}}'''Ann-Sofie Sandberg''' (born in 1951)<ref name=":0" /> is a Swedish food scientist. She is a professor in Food and Nutritional Science at [[Chalmers University of Technology]]. Sandberg research involves the bioavailability of nutrients and bioactive components in food, and understanding how to improve nutritional value in food. She was awarded the Gustaf Dalén Medal for outstanding scientific contributions in the field of food.

== Biography ==
Sandberg received her PhD in 1982 at the [[University of Gothenburg]].<ref name=":0" /> Her dissertation was on the 'Effects of Dietary Fibers on [[Ileostomy]] Patients'.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://libris.kb.se/bib/7625808?vw=short|title=LIBRIS - Dietary fibre - determination...|website=libris.kb.se|date=1982 |publisher=Gotab |isbn=978-91-7222-517-6 |language=sv|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref> Sandberg is the head of the food sciences department at Chalmers University of Technology, and is chair of the faculty, serving on the Chalmers board.<ref name=":0" /> 

In 2010, she was elected into the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://news.cision.com/se/kungl--ingenjorsvetenskapsakademien--iva/r/borje-ekholm--karin-forseke-och-elva-ytterligare-invalda-i-iva,c481070|title=Börje Ekholm, Karin Forseke och elva ytterligare invalda i IVA|website=News Powered by Cision|access-date=2018-08-29|archive-date=2017-11-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107024632/http://news.cision.com/se/kungl--ingenjorsvetenskapsakademien--iva/r/borje-ekholm--karin-forseke-och-elva-ytterligare-invalda-i-iva,c481070|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was awarded an honorary doctorate degree in 2013 at the [[Sahlgrenska Academy]] for strengthening the connections between medical and technological research in Gothenburg.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chalmers.se/sv/nyheter/Sidor/Ann-Sofie-Sandberg-ny-hedersdoktor-pa-Sahlgrenska.aspx|title=Ann-Sofie Sandberg ny hedersdoktor på Sahlgrenska|last=|first=|date=|website=www.chalmers.se|language=sv-se|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref>

In 2014 Sandberg was awarded the Gustaf Dalén Medal for "outstanding scientific contributions in the field of food, which have successfully contributed to strengthening Chalmers' brand as a university and as an internationally prominent research environment".<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Gustaf Dalén {{!}} Chalmersska Ingenjörsföreningen |url=https://avancez.se/om-oss/gustaf-dalen |access-date=2025-04-27 |website=avancez.se}}</ref> She has been awarded an honorary doctorate from the [[Sahlgrenska University Hospital|Sahlgrenska Academy]].<ref name=":1" />

== Work ==

Sandberg research involves the bioavailability of nutrients and bioactive components in food, and understanding how to improve nutritional value in food.<ref name=":1" /> Her research involves developing analysis techniques, and she has investigated the health effects of fish in the diet.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chalmers.se/en/Staff/Pages/Ann-Sofie-Sandberg.aspx|title=Ann-Sofie Sandberg|last=|first=|date=|website=www.chalmers.se|language=en-us|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref><ref name=":1" />

Sandberg has co-authored more than 300 publications within her research area.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://orcid.org/0000-0002-9681-3342|title=ORCID|last=ORCID|website=orcid.org|language=en|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref>

== Awards ==

* 2014 : Chalmers Gustaf Dalén Memorial Medal for "prominent academic contributions in food science".<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cing.chalmers.se/om-oss/gustaf-daln/20879/Page|title=Chalmersska Ingenjörsföreningen - CING - nätverket för examinerade från Chalmers|website=www.cing.chalmers.se|language=sv|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref>
